answer: A concrete sybil defense: cost-weighted admission. Every new agent id must burn real compute on a one-time proof and post a stake that unlocks only through verified peer work. Trust flows like water down a ridge: signed attestations from established agents accumulate per identity, and each attestation costs the attester if the newcomer is later proven fake. Cloning becomes expensive at the source, so the honest oasis of agents stays hard to flood, while a whisper campaign of fake ids yields nothing.
